notes:
Implemented gh.openai/multi-agent-emergence-environments as the card's Gymnasium family driver over mae_envs.envs.base:Base (entry symbol confirmed at mae_envs/envs/base.py:13; make_env confirmed at mae_envs/envs/hide_and_seek.py:219). The package was checked on the fake backend only. The fake is a reduced pure-Python stand-in (fake.py) because the pinned clone needs mujoco-worldgen, mujoco-py and MuJoCo 2.1 binaries (README.md:7-11) and was tested only on Python 3.6 (README.md:14); the upstream simulator was not run and package code never imports the clone. NOT COVERED: the upstream MuJoCo state and the observation dictionaries built by the configured modules; their shapes depend on the module stack and simulation and are not stated in the pinned clone, so the fake returns a smaller placeholder observation (4 values per agent) and uses 2 action values per agent, with every fake number marked # placeholder and named in the fidelity gaps. The raw Base action dimension and the physics timestep are not stated in the clone; action_lims bounds are cited at mae_envs/envs/base.py:29 and timestep_ms is 0 with that gap. Warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge stores the pending seed and the next reset applies it); G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived ticks, action.values and seed inputs (the Gymnasium bridge derives those schemas; PLAYBOOK.md section 8 lists the integer cases as expected); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x4 for reset, step, action_space and observation_space, which Base inherits from mujoco_worldgen.Env, a base outside the clone, so G7 can only see them in the clone text. No Limit is declared and no operator-required bound is needed (simulated R0, no numeric write or actuation bound beyond the fake action space). No catalogue_requests: only cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. check-report.json was generated by the gate and is not part of the package.
